summary: Home Manager Fractal staging accepts nested st3 state directories and safely handles a consumer's forced legacy config entry.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Legacy behavior is unchanged. Stage overrides force on the module-managed legacy config entry; completed disables that linker entry and preserves merged TOML in the guarded backing file. Nested state and sibling PTY paths retain their suffixes beneath the Fractal root.

downtime.detail: Staging alone does not require downtime. Changing package or service settings still has normal Home Manager restart behavior.

manual.detail: Existing forced generations must still be pruned when migration preflight reports them. Resolve ordinary config collisions before staging; force no longer bypasses them in the staged generation.

recovery.detail: Receipt guards and the persistent legacy-generation fence remain required. Never activate a forced old generation after cutover.
